newsitem.title: PERU: Lima shrs end broadly stable as investors cautious.
newsitem.headline: Lima shrs end broadly stable as investors cautious.

text.p: Shares on the Lima stock exchange closed broadly stable Tuesday as investors were generally cautious ahead of soon-to-be-published first-quarter company results, brokers said.
Profit-taking in some mining stocks after recent gains in the sector was offset by gains in the electricity sector, the brokers said.
Players expected a similar trend Wednesday, they said.
On Tuesday, the General Index dipped 0.02 percent to 1,739.09 points, while the blue-chip Selective Index was stable at 2,528.22 points.
In a total of 1,432 trades, volume was a meager 35.4 million soles ($13.4 million), according to preliminary figures.

"The market was stable because players are waiting to see companies' balance sheets," said Bruno Calle of local brokerage Argenta. "There was some profit-taking in leading miners. But the recent inactivity of electricity stocks allowed for rises in the sector."
There was little trading in benchmark Telefonica del Peru, which rose 0.95 percent to 6.36 soles in volume of 226,000 shares.
Polymetal miner Morococha, which has gained most in the sector's recent bull run, fell 2.88 percent to 2.70 soles on volume of 271,000 shares.
Polymetal miner Atacocha closed down 0.84 percent at 1.18 soles on 336,000 shares.
Electricity distributor Moyopampa -- formerly known as Edegel -- rose 1.53 percent to 1.33 soles on 391,000 shares.
